---
title: "Popular Support For Trade Agreements And Partner Country Characteristics"
description: "Economic Inquiry, 2021. With Tom Coupé."
date: "2021-01-01"
status: "published"
categories: [consultancy, trade-wars]
---

Public support for a trade agreement depends not just on its expected
economic effects but on characteristics of the partner country — including
factors with no direct bearing on trade volumes, such as perceived
political alignment and cultural distance. We use survey experiments to
separate economic from non-economic drivers of trade-agreement support, with
direct implications for how governments should sequence and communicate
new trade deals.

**Published in:** *Economic Inquiry*, 59(1), 549–566
